title: Add Corner Sticker (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Add Corner Sticker applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Add Corner Sticker (BtnAddSticker) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Add Sticker creates exactly one preset sticker in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Add Sticker bounded preset (text plus BGR fill color) on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
